Exercises the metadata precedence in `lib/seo.ts`. The body deliberately mentions none of
the strings the smoke check excludes — an assertion that the *generated* card is absent
would otherwise be satisfied by this prose describing it.

- The frontmatter image must beat the auto-generated card.
- The explicit card type must beat the wide default.
- A namespaced key we don't model must be passed through verbatim.
- The site-wide tags in `docs.json` must still apply.
